iterations.finding: The JSON Schema could not express the cross-field invariant; two abstention outputs were internally contradictory and failed Pydantic validation.
Structured output and citations reached 100%, but model classification and one critical abstention remained below the frozen gate.

iterations.design: Discriminated union plus explicit decision order
iterations.finding: Prompt strengthening did not reliably enforce missing-context and multi-target abstention, so probabilistic prompt rules were rejected as the safety boundary.

iterations.design: Deterministic scope preflight plus strict discriminated-union model labeling
iterations.finding: The preflight handled two non-classifiable cases without inference; qwen3.5 labeled the six single-target cases and the complete pipeline passed every frozen gate.
All eight calls exceeded the 120 second request timeout, so qwen3.8 cannot satisfy the 30 second p95 gate and was not rerun after the schema redesign.

qwen38_runtime_observation.reason: The initial evaluator did not query /api/ps on error.
qwen38_runtime_observation.claim_boundary: The manually observed process size is retained separately and is not treated as an exact measured byte metric.

selection.pipeline: deterministic target-scope preflight -> qwen3.5 structured labeling -> deterministic scoring/aggregation
selection.decision: Eligible for the next production-adapter slice on the tested M5/24 GB/Ollama environment.

limitations: All eight evaluation samples are explicit synthetic fixtures; this does not establish quality on real platform language, slang or sarcasm.
Results apply to one Apple M5 machine with 24 GB memory, Ollama 0.33.2 and the recorded model digests.
The deterministic preflight recognizes only the three frozen MVP targets and must version its marker policy when production taxonomy changes.
This POC did not connect to external platforms, the existing MinIO instance, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, a production worker or any paid API.
No production ai adapter, migration, HTTP endpoint, Swagger change, generated frontend API or user interface was added.
The selected model remains a candidate until production timeout, concurrency, resource isolation, persistence and real frozen-sample acceptance are implemented.
